name: mathe-abenteuer
description: Denkzauber – offline math practice app for German Klasse 4 (workbook chapters A–D + Extra Spaß, Europa Entdecker, Meine Welt)

scripts.test: python3 build.py && cd tests && node gen_test.js && node extra_test.js && node flow_test.js
scripts.test:all: npm test && cd tests && for t in migrate economy avatar musik themes geo world dz packs round5 noten; do python3 ${t}_test.py $(realpath ../dist/Mathe-Abenteuer_Klasse4.html) || exit 1; done
